_readme: firstJoinGift.guideBook - give a Guide Book to each player the first time they join a world.
firstJoinGift.workbench - give a Block Pack Workbench to each player on that same first join.
Set either to false to disable it for this whole instance -- intended for modpacks and servers
that hand out their own starting items. The Settings page in the guide book has a per-world
toggle for the same gift, but it can only turn OFF what is enabled here, never turn ON what is
disabled here; with both items off the in-game toggle is shown as locked.
Both the Guide Book and the Workbench stay craftable no matter what these are set to.
